scientific_limitations: Restricted to real free spaces over unweighted Boolean Hamming cubes and independent coordinate noise.
The relevant published coordinate-shadow theorem for idempotent Walsh spectral projections uses a closely related technique; originality of the time-dependent peak law is provisional.
No statement about weighted Hamming metrics or general graph Markov semigroups.
title: A sharp dimension threshold and logarithmic transient peak for Boolean heat flow on Lipschitz-free spaces
